   *     createdAt: true
   *   },
   *   _count: {
   *     _all: true
   *   },
   * })
   * 
  **/
  groupBy<
    T extends PrincipalGroupByArgs,
    HasSelectOrTake extends Prisma.Or<
      Prisma.Extends<'skip', Prisma.Keys<T>>,
      Prisma.Extends<'take', Prisma.Keys<T>>
    >,
    OrderByArg extends Prisma.True extends HasSelectOrTake
      ? { orderBy: PrincipalGroupByArgs['orderBy'] }
      : { orderBy?: PrincipalGroupByArgs['orderBy'] },
    OrderFields extends Prisma.ExcludeUnderscoreKeys<Prisma.Keys<Prisma.MaybeTupleToUnion<T['orderBy']>>>,
    ByFields extends Prisma.MaybeTupleToUnion<T['by']>,
    ByValid extends Prisma.Has<ByFields, OrderFields>,
    HavingFields extends Prisma.GetHavingFields<T['having']>,
    HavingValid extends Prisma.Has<ByFields, HavingFields>,
    ByEmpty extends T['by'] extends never[] ? Prisma.True : Prisma.False,
    InputErrors extends ByEmpty extends Prisma.True
    ? `Error: "by" must not be empty.`
    : HavingValid extends Prisma.False
    ? {
        [P in HavingFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : P extends string
          ? `Error: Field "${P}" used in "having" needs to be provided in "by".`
          : [
              Error,
              'Field ',
              P,
              ` in "having" needs to be provided in "by"`,
            ]
      }[HavingFields]
    : 'take' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "take", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : 'skip' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "skip", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : ByValid extends Prisma.True
    ? {}
    : {
        [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
      }[OrderFields]
  >(args: Prisma.SubsetIntersection<T, PrincipalGroupByArgs, OrderByArg> & InputErrors): {} extends InputErrors ? GetPrincipalGroupByPayload<T> : Prisma.PrismaPromise<InputErrors>
/**
 * Fields of the Principal model
 */
readonly fields: PrincipalFieldRefs;

/**
 * The delegate class that acts as a "Promise-like" for Principal.

          : P extends string

      : 'Error: If you provide "take", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : 'skip' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "skip", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : ByValid extends Prisma.True
    ? {}
    : {
        [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
      }[OrderFields]

/**
 * The delegate class that acts as a "Promise-like" for Result.
 * Why is this prefixed with `Prisma__`?
 * Because we want to prevent naming conflicts as mentioned in
 * https://github.com/prisma/prisma-client-js/issues/707
 */
export interface Prisma__ResultClient<T, Null = never, ExtArgs extends runtime.Types.Extensions.InternalArgs = runtime.Types.Extensions.DefaultArgs, GlobalOmitOptions = {}> extends Prisma.PrismaPromise<T> {
  readonly [Symbol.toStringTag]: "PrismaPromise"
  student<T extends Prisma.StudentDefaultArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.StudentDefaultArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.Prisma__StudentClient<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$StudentPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findUniqueOrThrow", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null, Null, ExtArgs, GlobalOmitOptions>
  exam<T extends Prisma.ExamDefaultArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.ExamDefaultArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.Prisma__ExamClient<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$ExamPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findUniqueOrThrow", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null, Null, ExtArgs, GlobalOmitOptions>
  subjects<T extends Prisma.Result$subjectsArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Result$subjectsArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$ResultSubjectPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>
  /**
   * Attaches callbacks for the resolution and/or rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onfulfilled The callback to execute when the Promise is resolved.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of which ever callback is executed.
   */
  then<TResult1 = T, TResult2 = never>(onfulfilled?: ((value: T) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | undefined | null, onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<TResult1 | TResult2>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback for only the rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  catch<TResult = never>(onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult | PromiseLike<TResult>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T | TResult>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback that is invoked when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected). The
   * resolved value cannot be modified from the callback.
   * @param onfinally The callback to execute when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected).
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  finally(onfinally?: (() => void) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T>
}

   *   }
   * })
  **/
  count<T extends SettingCountArgs>(
    args?: Prisma.Subset<T, SettingCountArgs>,
  ): Prisma.PrismaPromise<
    T extends runtime.Types.Utils.Record<'select', any>
      ? T['select'] extends true
        ? number
        : Prisma.GetScalarType<T['select'], SettingCountAggregateOutputType>
      : number
  >

   * Allows you to perform aggregations operations on a Setting.
   * Note, that providing `undefined` is treated as the value not being there.
   * Read more here: https://pris.ly/d/null-undefined
   * @param {SettingAggregateArgs} args - Select which aggregations you would like to apply and on what fields.
   * @example
   * // Ordered by age ascending
   * // Where email contains prisma.io
   * // Limited to the 10 users
   * const aggregations = await prisma.user.aggregate({
   *   _avg: {
   *     age: true,
   *   },
   *   where: {
   *     email: {
   *       contains: "prisma.io",
   *     },
   *   },
   *   orderBy: {
   *     age: "asc",
   *   },
   *   take: 10,
   * })
  **/
  aggregate<T extends SettingAggregateArgs>(args: Prisma.Subset<T, SettingAggregateArgs>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<GetSettingAggregateType<T>>

  /**
   * Group by Setting.
   * Note, that providing `undefined` is treated as the value not being there.
   * Read more here: https://pris.ly/d/null-undefined
   * @param {SettingGroupByArgs} args - Group by arguments.
   * @example
   * // Group by city, order by createdAt, get count
   * const result = await prisma.user.groupBy({
   *   by: ['city', 'createdAt'],
   *   orderBy: {
   *     createdAt: true
   *   },
   *   _count: {
   *     _all: true
   *   },
   * })
   * 
  **/
  groupBy<
    T extends SettingGroupByArgs,
    HasSelectOrTake extends Prisma.Or<
      Prisma.Extends<'skip', Prisma.Keys<T>>,
      Prisma.Extends<'take', Prisma.Keys<T>>
    >,
    OrderByArg extends Prisma.True extends HasSelectOrTake
      ? { orderBy: SettingGroupByArgs['orderBy'] }
      : { orderBy?: SettingGroupByArgs['orderBy'] },
    OrderFields extends Prisma.ExcludeUnderscoreKeys<Prisma.Keys<Prisma.MaybeTupleToUnion<T['orderBy']>>>,
    ByFields extends Prisma.MaybeTupleToUnion<T['by']>,
    ByValid extends Prisma.Has<ByFields, OrderFields>,
    HavingFields extends Prisma.GetHavingFields<T['having']>,
    HavingValid extends Prisma.Has<ByFields, HavingFields>,
    ByEmpty extends T['by'] extends never[] ? Prisma.True : Prisma.False,
    InputErrors extends ByEmpty extends Prisma.True
    ? `Error: "by" must not be empty.`
    : HavingValid extends Prisma.False
    ? {
        [P in HavingFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : P extends string
          ? `Error: Field "${P}" used in "having" needs to be provided in "by".`
          : [
              Error,
              'Field ',
              P,
              ` in "having" needs to be provided in "by"`,
            ]
      }[HavingFields]
    : 'take' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "take", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : 'skip' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "skip", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : ByValid extends Prisma.True
    ? {}
    : {
        [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
      }[OrderFields]
  >(args: Prisma.SubsetIntersection<T, SettingGroupByArgs, OrderByArg> & InputErrors): {} extends InputErrors ? GetSettingGroupByPayload<T> : Prisma.PrismaPromise<InputErrors>
/**
 * Fields of the Setting model
 */
readonly fields: SettingFieldRefs;

/**
 * The delegate class that acts as a "Promise-like" for Setting.
 * Why is this prefixed with `Prisma__`?
 * Because we want to prevent naming conflicts as mentioned in
 * https://github.com/prisma/prisma-client-js/issues/707
 */
export interface Prisma__SettingClient<T, Null = never, ExtArgs extends runtime.Types.Extensions.InternalArgs = runtime.Types.Extensions.DefaultArgs, GlobalOmitOptions = {}> extends Prisma.PrismaPromise<T> {
  readonly [Symbol.toStringTag]: "PrismaPromise"
  /**
   * Attaches callbacks for the resolution and/or rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onfulfilled The callback to execute when the Promise is resolved.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of which ever callback is executed.
   */
  then<TResult1 = T, TResult2 = never>(onfulfilled?: ((value: T) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | undefined | null, onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<TResult1 | TResult2>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback for only the rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  catch<TResult = never>(onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult | PromiseLike<TResult>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T | TResult>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback that is invoked when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected). The
   * resolved value cannot be modified from the callback.
   * @param onfinally The callback to execute when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected).
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  finally(onfinally?: (() => void) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T>
}

  readonly updatedBy: Prisma.FieldRef<"Setting", 'String'>
  readonly deletedAt: Prisma.FieldRef<"Setting", 'DateTime'>
}

/**
 * The delegate class that acts as a "Promise-like" for Staff.
 * Why is this prefixed with `Prisma__`?
 * Because we want to prevent naming conflicts as mentioned in
 * https://github.com/prisma/prisma-client-js/issues/707
 */
export interface Prisma__StaffClient<T, Null = never, ExtArgs extends runtime.Types.Extensions.InternalArgs = runtime.Types.Extensions.DefaultArgs, GlobalOmitOptions = {}> extends Prisma.PrismaPromise<T> {
  readonly [Symbol.toStringTag]: "PrismaPromise"
  employee<T extends Prisma.EmployeeDefaultArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.EmployeeDefaultArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.Prisma__EmployeeClient<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$EmployeePayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findUniqueOrThrow", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null, Null, ExtArgs, GlobalOmitOptions>
  /**
   * Attaches callbacks for the resolution and/or rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onfulfilled The callback to execute when the Promise is resolved.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of which ever callback is executed.
   */
  then<TResult1 = T, TResult2 = never>(onfulfilled?: ((value: T) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | undefined | null, onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<TResult1 | TResult2>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback for only the rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  catch<TResult = never>(onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult | PromiseLike<TResult>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T | TResult>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback that is invoked when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected). The
   * resolved value cannot be modified from the callback.
   * @param onfinally The callback to execute when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected).
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  finally(onfinally?: (() => void) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T>
}

   * Note, that providing `undefined` is treated as the value not being there.

   *   orderBy: {
   *     createdAt: true
   *   },
   *   _count: {
   *     _all: true
   *   },
   * })
   * 
  **/
  groupBy<
    T extends StudentGroupByArgs,
    HasSelectOrTake extends Prisma.Or<
      Prisma.Extends<'skip', Prisma.Keys<T>>,
      Prisma.Extends<'take', Prisma.Keys<T>>
    >,
    OrderByArg extends Prisma.True extends HasSelectOrTake
      ? { orderBy: StudentGroupByArgs['orderBy'] }
      : { orderBy?: StudentGroupByArgs['orderBy'] },
    OrderFields extends Prisma.ExcludeUnderscoreKeys<Prisma.Keys<Prisma.MaybeTupleToUnion<T['orderBy']>>>,
    ByFields extends Prisma.MaybeTupleToUnion<T['by']>,
    ByValid extends Prisma.Has<ByFields, OrderFields>,
    HavingFields extends Prisma.GetHavingFields<T['having']>,
    HavingValid extends Prisma.Has<ByFields, HavingFields>,
    ByEmpty extends T['by'] extends never[] ? Prisma.True : Prisma.False,
    InputErrors extends ByEmpty extends Prisma.True
    ? `Error: "by" must not be empty.`
    : HavingValid extends Prisma.False
    ? {
        [P in HavingFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : P extends string
          ? `Error: Field "${P}" used in "having" needs to be provided in "by".`
          : [
              Error,
              'Field ',
              P,
              ` in "having" needs to be provided in "by"`,
            ]
      }[HavingFields]
    : 'take' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "take", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : 'skip' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
    ? 'orderBy' extends Prisma.Keys<T>
      ? ByValid extends Prisma.True
        ? {}
        : {
            [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
              ? never
              : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
          }[OrderFields]
      : 'Error: If you provide "skip", you also need to provide "orderBy"'
    : ByValid extends Prisma.True
    ? {}
    : {
        [P in OrderFields]: P extends ByFields
          ? never
          : `Error: Field "${P}" in "orderBy" needs to be provided in "by"`
      }[OrderFields]
  >(args: Prisma.SubsetIntersection<T, StudentGroupByArgs, OrderByArg> & InputErrors): {} extends InputErrors ? GetStudentGroupByPayload<T> : Prisma.PrismaPromise<InputErrors>

/**
 * The delegate class that acts as a "Promise-like" for Student.
 * Why is this prefixed with `Prisma__`?
 * Because we want to prevent naming conflicts as mentioned in
 * https://github.com/prisma/prisma-client-js/issues/707
 */
export interface Prisma__StudentClient<T, Null = never, ExtArgs extends runtime.Types.Extensions.InternalArgs = runtime.Types.Extensions.DefaultArgs, GlobalOmitOptions = {}> extends Prisma.PrismaPromise<T> {
  readonly [Symbol.toStringTag]: "PrismaPromise"
  user<T extends Prisma.Student$userArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Student$userArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.Prisma__UserClient<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$UserPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findUniqueOrThrow", GlobalOmitOptions> | null, null, ExtArgs, GlobalOmitOptions>

  guardians<T extends Prisma.Student$guardiansArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Student$guardiansArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$GuardianPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>
  attendances<T extends Prisma.Student$attendancesArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Student$attendancesArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$StudentAttendancePayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>
  marks<T extends Prisma.Student$marksArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Student$marksArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$ExamMarkPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>
  results<T extends Prisma.Student$resultsArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Student$resultsArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$ResultPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>
  fees<T extends Prisma.Student$feesArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.Student$feesArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$StudentFeePayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>

  /**
   * Attaches callbacks for the resolution and/or rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onfulfilled The callback to execute when the Promise is resolved.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of which ever callback is executed.
   */
  then<TResult1 = T, TResult2 = never>(onfulfilled?: ((value: T) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | undefined | null, onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<TResult1 | TResult2>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback for only the rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  catch<TResult = never>(onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult | PromiseLike<TResult>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T | TResult>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback that is invoked when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected). The

  /**

/**
 * The delegate class that acts as a "Promise-like" for User.
 * Why is this prefixed with `Prisma__`?
 * Because we want to prevent naming conflicts as mentioned in
 * https://github.com/prisma/prisma-client-js/issues/707
 */
export interface Prisma__UserClient<T, Null = never, ExtArgs extends runtime.Types.Extensions.InternalArgs = runtime.Types.Extensions.DefaultArgs, GlobalOmitOptions = {}> extends Prisma.PrismaPromise<T> {
  readonly [Symbol.toStringTag]: "PrismaPromise"
  otps<T extends Prisma.User$otpsArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.User$otpsArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.PrismaPromise<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$OtpPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findMany", GlobalOmitOptions> | Null>
  employee<T extends Prisma.User$employeeArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.User$employeeArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.Prisma__EmployeeClient<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$EmployeePayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findUniqueOrThrow", GlobalOmitOptions> | null, null, ExtArgs, GlobalOmitOptions>
  student<T extends Prisma.User$studentArgs<ExtArgs> = {}>(args?: Prisma.Subset<T, Prisma.User$studentArgs<ExtArgs>>): Prisma.Prisma__StudentClient<runtime.Types.Result.GetResult<Prisma.$StudentPayload<ExtArgs>, T, "findUniqueOrThrow", GlobalOmitOptions> | null, null, ExtArgs, GlobalOmitOptions>
  /**
   * Attaches callbacks for the resolution and/or rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onfulfilled The callback to execute when the Promise is resolved.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of which ever callback is executed.
   */
  then<TResult1 = T, TResult2 = never>(onfulfilled?: ((value: T) => TResult1 | PromiseLike<TResult1>) | undefined | null, onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult2 | PromiseLike<TResult2>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<TResult1 | TResult2>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback for only the rejection of the Promise.
   * @param onrejected The callback to execute when the Promise is rejected.
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  catch<TResult = never>(onrejected?: ((reason: any) => TResult | PromiseLike<TResult>) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T | TResult>
  /**
   * Attaches a callback that is invoked when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected). The
   * resolved value cannot be modified from the callback.
   * @param onfinally The callback to execute when the Promise is settled (fulfilled or rejected).
   * @returns A Promise for the completion of the callback.
   */
  finally(onfinally?: (() => void) | undefined | null): runtime.Types.Utils.JsPromise<T>
}

import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from "express";
import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { ResponseHandler } from "@/utils/response";
import { ErrorHandler } from "@/utils/error";

// Keep in sync with `enum Role` in schema.prisma
export type T_Role =
  | "ADMIN"
  | "PRINCIPAL"
  | "ACCOUNTANT"
  | "TEACHER"
  | "STAFF"
  | "STUDENT";

// Must be used AFTER isUser, because it reads res.locals.context.userId
export const isAuthorizedTo = (...allowedRoles: T_Role[]) => {
  // Fail at startup (not at request time) if someone passes no roles
  if (allowedRoles.length === 0)
    throw new Error("canBeAccessedBy needs at least one role");

  return async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    try {
      // Get the user info set by the isUser middleware
      const context = res.locals.context;

      if (!context?.userId)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 401,
          message: "Unauthorized",
          error: null,
        });

      // Check the role from the database, not only from the token
      const user = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: {
          id: context.userId,
          role: { in: allowedRoles },
          isActive: true,
          deletedAt: null,
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      // If the user's role is not in the allowed list, block the request
      if (!user)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 403,
          message: "You do not have permission to perform this action",
          error: null,
        });

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  };
};

import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
import { AuthService } from "../modules/auth/service";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { T_Context } from "@/@types/type";
import { CookieManager } from "@/utils/cookies";

export const isUser = async (
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) => {
  try {
    // Get the token from cookie or authorization header
    const token = req.cookies.token || req.headers.authorization?.split(" ")[1];
    const refreshToken = req.cookies.refreshToken;

    // Validate Tokens
    const decoded = token ? AuthService.verifyToken(token) : null;
    const decodedRefresh = refreshToken
      ? AuthService.verifyToken(refreshToken)
      : null;

    // Create userContext from decoded token data
    let userContext: T_Context;

    // If both tokens are invalid or missing , throw unauthorized error
    if (!decoded && !decodedRefresh) {
      throw new CustomError("Unauthorized", 401);
    }

    // If the token is invalid but the refresh token is valid, refresh the token
    if (!decoded && decodedRefresh) {
      const tokenData = decodedRefresh as T_Context;
      const newToken = AuthService.generateToken(
        tokenData.userId,
        tokenData.role,
      );

      // Set the new token in cookies
      res.cookie("token", newToken, CookieManager.accessToken());

      // Also send the new token in response header for clients using Authorization header
      res.setHeader("Authorization", `Bearer ${newToken}`);
      // Use the refresh token data as context
      userContext = tokenData;
    } else {
      // Use the decoded token data as context
      userContext = decoded as T_Context;
    }
    // Attach user info to response locals
    res.locals.context = userContext;
    return next();
  } catch (error) {
    // If any error occurs, handle the error
    return res
      .status(401)
      .json({ success: false, message: "Unauthorized", error });
  }
};

export const isAdmin = async (
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) => {
  try {
    // Get the token from cookie or authorization header
    const token = req.cookies.token || req.headers.authorization?.split(" ")[1];
    const refreshToken = req.cookies.refreshToken;

    // Validate Tokens
    const decoded = token ? AuthService.verifyToken(token) : null;
    const decodedRefresh = refreshToken
      ? AuthService.verifyToken(refreshToken)
      : null;

    // Create userContext from decoded token data
    let userContext: T_Context;

    // If both tokens are invalid or missing , throw unauthorized error
    if (!decoded && !decodedRefresh) {
      throw new CustomError("Unauthorized", 401);
    }

    // If the token is invalid but the refresh token is valid, refresh the token
    if (!decoded && decodedRefresh) {
      const tokenData = decodedRefresh as T_Context;
      const newToken = AuthService.generateToken(
        tokenData.userId,
        tokenData.role,
      );

      // Set the new token in cookies
      res.cookie("token", newToken, CookieManager.accessToken());

      // Also send the new token in response header for clients using Authorization header
      res.setHeader("Authorization", `Bearer ${newToken}`);
      // Use the refresh token data as context
      userContext = tokenData;
    } else {
      // Use the decoded token data as context
      userContext = decoded as T_Context;
    }

    // Check if user is admin
    if (userContext.role !== "ADMIN") {
      throw new CustomError("Forbidden: Admin access required", 403);
    }

    // Attach user info to response locals
    res.locals.context = userContext;
    return next();
  } catch (error) {
    // If any error occurs, handle the error
    return res
      .status(401)
      .json({ success: false, message: "Unauthorized", error });
  }
};

import { NextFunction, Request, Response } from "express";

export const trimBody = function (
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  try {
    if (req.body && req.body !== undefined && typeof req.body === "object") {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(req.body)) {
        if (typeof value === "string") req.body[key] = value.trim();
      }
    }

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    // If any error occurs, handle the error
    return res.status(500).send({
      success: false,
      message: "Internal Server Error",
      error,
    });
  }
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { AccountCreateInput } from "./validator";

export const AccountService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { code: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { name: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    const [accounts, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.account.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        include: {
          children: true,
          journalLines: true,
        },
      }),
      prismaMain.account.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: accounts,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: AccountCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    try {
      const account = await prismaMain.account.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          ...(userId && { createdBy: userId }),
        } as any,
        include: {
          children: true,
          journalLines: true,
        },
      });
      return account;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("An account with this code already exists", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const account = await prismaMain.account.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        children: true,
        journalLines: true,
      },
    });

    if (!account) {
      throw new CustomError("Account not found", 404);
    }

    return account;
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.account.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Account not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.account.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { calculateSkipAndTake } from "@/utils/queryFilters";
import { AccountTypeCreateInput, AccountTypeUpdateInput } from "./validator";

export const AccountTypeService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit ? query.limit : 10; // limit = -1 returns everything (useful for dropdowns)
    const { skip, take } = calculateSkipAndTake(page, limit);

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { code: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { name: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.accountType.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take,
        orderBy: [{ sortOrder: "asc" }, { name: "asc" }],
      }),
      prismaMain.accountType.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: AccountTypeCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // The unique index on code also covers soft-deleted rows, so check without the deletedAt filter
    const existing = await prismaMain.accountType.findFirst({
      where: { code: data.code },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError(
        existing.deletedAt
          ? "A deleted account type already uses this code. Use a different code."
          : "An account type with this code already exists",
        409,
      );
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.accountType.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError(
          "An account type with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const item = await prismaMain.accountType.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!item) {
      throw new CustomError("Account type not found", 404);
    }

    return item;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: AccountTypeUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.accountType.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Account type not found", 404);
    }

    if (data.code && data.code !== existing.code) {
      const duplicate = await prismaMain.accountType.findFirst({
        where: { code: data.code, NOT: { id } },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new CustomError(
          "An account type with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.accountType.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError(
          "An account type with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.accountType.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Account type not found", 404);
    }

    // Block deletion while other records still reference this row
    const usage = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.account.count({
        where: { accountTypeId: id, deletedAt: null },
      }),
    ]);

    if (usage.some((count) => count > 0)) {
      throw new CustomError(
        "This account type is in use and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.",
        409,
      );
    }

    await prismaMain.accountType.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { z } from "zod";

export const accountTypeCreateInputSchema = z.object({
  code: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, "Code is required")
    .max(50, "Code is too long")
    .transform((value) => value.toUpperCase()),
  name: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, "Name is required")
    .max(255, "Name is too long"),
  isDebitNormal: z.boolean(),
  sortOrder: z.number().int().min(0).default(0),
});

  accountTypeCreateInputSchema.partial();

  typeof accountTypeCreateInputSchema
>;
export type AccountTypeUpdateInput = z.infer<
  typeof accountTypeUpdateInputSchema
>;

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { AccountantCreateInput } from "./validator";

export const AccountantService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { employee: { firstName: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } } },
        { employee: { lastName: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } } },
        { employee: { employeeCode: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } } },
      ];
    }

    const [accountants, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.accountant.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          employee: true,
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.accountant.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: accountants,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: AccountantCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // Validate employee exists and is not soft-deleted
    const employee = await prismaMain.employee.findFirst({
      where: { id: data.employeeId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!employee) {
      throw new CustomError("Employee not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    try {
      const accountant = await prismaMain.accountant.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          employeeId: data.employeeId,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          employee: true,
        },
      });
      return accountant;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("An employee is already assigned as Accountant", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const accountant = await prismaMain.accountant.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        employee: true,
      },
    });

    if (!accountant) {
      throw new CustomError("Accountant not found", 404);
    }

    return accountant;
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const accountant = await prismaMain.accountant.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!accountant) {
      throw new CustomError("Accountant not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.accountant.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { AttendanceSessionCreateInput } from "./validator";

export const AttendanceSessionService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { dateBs: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    const [sessions, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.attendanceSession.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          records: true,
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.attendanceSession.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: sessions,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: AttendanceSessionCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    try {
      const session = await prismaMain.attendanceSession.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          ...(userId && { createdBy: userId }),
        },
        include: {
          records: true,
        },
      });
      return session;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("An attendance session with this date already exists", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const session = await prismaMain.attendanceSession.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        records: true,
      },
    });

    if (!session) {
      throw new CustomError("Attendance session not found", 404);
    }

    return session;
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.attendanceSession.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Attendance session not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.attendanceSession.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { calculateSkipAndTake } from "@/utils/queryFilters";
import {
  AttendanceStatusCreateInput,
  AttendanceStatusUpdateInput,
} from "./validator";

export const AttendanceStatusService = {
  async index(query: {
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
    search?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
  }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit ? query.limit : 10; // limit = -1 returns everything (useful for dropdowns)
    const { skip, take } = calculateSkipAndTake(page, limit);

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { code: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { name: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
      whereClause.isActive = query.isActive;
    }

    const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.attendanceStatus.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take,
        orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.attendanceStatus.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: AttendanceStatusCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // The unique index on code also covers soft-deleted rows, so check without the deletedAt filter
    const existing = await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.findFirst({
      where: { code: data.code },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError(
        existing.deletedAt
          ? "A deleted attendance status already uses this code. Use a different code."
          : "An attendance status with this code already exists",
        409,
      );
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError(
          "An attendance status with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const item = await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!item) {
      throw new CustomError("Attendance status not found", 404);
    }

    return item;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: AttendanceStatusUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Attendance status not found", 404);
    }

    if (data.code && data.code !== existing.code) {
      const duplicate = await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.findFirst({
        where: { code: data.code, NOT: { id } },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new CustomError(
          "An attendance status with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError(
          "An attendance status with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Attendance status not found", 404);
    }

    // Block deletion while other records still reference this row
    const usage = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.studentAttendance.count({
        where: { statusId: id, deletedAt: null },
      }),
      prismaMain.employeeAttendance.count({
        where: { statusId: id, deletedAt: null },
      }),
    ]);

    if (usage.some((count) => count > 0)) {
      throw new CustomError(
        "This attendance status is in use and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.",
        409,
      );
    }

    await prismaMain.attendanceStatus.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { z } from "zod";

export const attendanceStatusCreateInputSchema = z.object({
  code: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, "Code is required")
    .max(50, "Code is too long")
    .transform((value) => value.toUpperCase()),
  name: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, "Name is required")
    .max(255, "Name is too long"),
  // 1 = full pay/present, 0.5 = half day, 0 = no pay
  salaryFactor: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(1),
  isActive: z.boolean().default(true),
});

export const attendanceStatusUpdateInputSchema =

import { prismaMain } from "../../lib/prismaClient";
import { ResponseHandler } from "../../utils/response";
import { ValidateLogin, ValidateRegister } from "./validator";
import type { Request, Response } from "express";
import bcrypt from "bcrypt";
import { ErrorHandler } from "@/utils/error";
import { AuthService } from "./service";
import { CookieManager } from "@/utils/cookies";

const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;
const MAX_FAILED_LOGINS = 5;
const LOCK_MINUTES = 15;

// Public registration must never decide its own role (privilege escalation).
// Change this to whatever role self-registered users should get.
const DEFAULT_REGISTER_ROLE = "STUDENT" as const;

export const AuthController = {
  test: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Auth API is working!",
        data: {
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
  dbTest: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    try {
      // Simple query to check PostgreSQL is reachable and ready
      await prismaMain.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "PostgreSQL is ready for queries!",
        data: {
          status: "connected",
          responseTimeMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ResponseHandler.error({
        res,
        code: 503,
        message: "PostgreSQL is not ready.",
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  },
  login: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      // Validate the Login Input
      const { email, password } = ValidateLogin(req.body);

      // Find user in the DataBase (ignore soft deleted users)
      const user = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { email, deletedAt: null },
      });

      // If User is not found , Throw Error
      if (!user)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 400,
          message: "Invalid Credentials",
          error: null,
        });

      // If the account is temporarily locked, stop here
      if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date())
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 423,
          message: "Account is temporarily locked. Please try again later.",
          error: null,
        });

      // Verify Password
      const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.passwordHash);

      // If Password doesn't match, count the failure and lock after too many
      if (!isPasswordValid) {
        const failedLoginCount = user.failedLoginCount + 1;
        const shouldLock = failedLoginCount >= MAX_FAILED_LOGINS;

        await prismaMain.user.update({
          where: { id: user.id },
          data: {
            failedLoginCount: shouldLock ? 0 : failedLoginCount,
            lockedUntil: shouldLock
              ? new Date(Date.now() + LOCK_MINUTES * 60 * 1000)
              : null,
          },
        });

        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 400,
          message: "Invalid Credentials",
          error: null,
        });
      }

      // Password is correct, but the account may be deactivated by admin
      if (!user.isActive)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 403,
          message: "Your account is deactivated. Please contact the admin.",
          error: null,
        });

      // Reset the failed attempts and save the last login time
      await prismaMain.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: {
          failedLoginCount: 0,
          lockedUntil: null,
          lastLoginAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      // Generate JWT token
      const token = AuthService.generateToken(user.id, user.role);

      // Generate refresh token
      const refreshToken = AuthService.generateRefreshToken(user.id);

      // Set the token in cookies
      res.cookie("token", token, CookieManager.accessToken());
      res.cookie("refreshToken", refreshToken, CookieManager.refreshToken());

      return res.status(200).json({
        message: "Login successful!",
        user: {
          id: user.id,
          username: user.username,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
        },
        token: token,
        refreshToken: refreshToken,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
  register: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      // Validate data from the body
      const { username, email, password } = ValidateRegister(req.body);

      // Check Whether email is Taken or Not
      // (no deletedAt filter, because @unique on email also blocks soft deleted rows)
      const existingEmail = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { email },
      });

      // If Email is taken then send error message
      if (existingEmail)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 400,
          message: "Email is already taken.",
          error: null,
        });

      // Check Whether Username is Taken or Not
      const existingUsername = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { username },
      });

      // If Username is taken then send error message
      if (existingUsername)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 400,
          message: "Username is already taken",
          error: null,
        });

      // Hash the password before saving
      const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);

      // Creating User
      await prismaMain.user.create({
        data: { email, username, passwordHash, role: DEFAULT_REGISTER_ROLE },
      });

      return res.status(201).json({
        message: "Registered successful!",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
  refresh: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      // Get the refresh token from cookie (or body as fallback)
      const incomingToken = req.cookies?.refreshToken ?? req.body?.refreshToken;

      if (!incomingToken)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 401,
          message: "Refresh token is required",
          error: null,
        });

      // Verify that it is a valid refresh token
      const payload = AuthService.verifyRefreshToken(incomingToken);

      if (!payload)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 401,
          message: "Invalid or expired refresh token",
          error: null,
        });

      // The user must still exist and be active
      const user = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { id: payload.userId, deletedAt: null, isActive: true },
      });

      if (!user)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 401,
          message: "Invalid or expired refresh token",
          error: null,
        });

      // Generate new tokens
      const token = AuthService.generateToken(user.id, user.role);
      const refreshToken = AuthService.generateRefreshToken(user.id);

      res.cookie("token", token, CookieManager.accessToken());
      res.cookie("refreshToken", refreshToken, CookieManager.refreshToken());

      return res.status(200).json({
        message: "Token refreshed successfully!",
        token: token,
        refreshToken: refreshToken,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
  me: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      // Get the user info from the response locals
      const context = res.locals.context;

      // Get the user by id
      const user = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { id: context.userId, deletedAt: null },
        select: { id: true, email: true, username: true, role: true },
      });

      // If user no longer exists
      if (!user)
        return ResponseHandler.error({
          res,
          code: 404,
          message: "User not found",
          error: null,
        });

      // Return the success response
      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "User fetched successfully!",
        data: user,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
  logout: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      // Clear the cookies
      res.clearCookie("token");
      res.clearCookie("refreshToken");
      return res.status(200).json({
        message: "Logged out successfully!",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
};

import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";
import "dotenv/config";

export const AuthService = {
  generateToken: (userId: string, role: string): string => {
    const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
    if (!secret) throw new Error("JWT_SECRET is not defined in .env");

    return jwt.sign({ userId, role, type: "access" }, secret, {
      expiresIn: Number(process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN) || 3600,
    });
  },
  generateRefreshToken: (userId: string): string => {
    const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
    if (!secret) throw new Error("JWT_SECRET is not defined in .env");

    return jwt.sign({ userId, type: "refresh" }, secret, {
      expiresIn: Number(process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN) || 86400,
    });
  },
  verifyToken: (token: string) => {
    try {
      const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
      if (!secret) throw new Error("JWT_SECRET is not defined");
      const decoded = jwt.verify(token, secret);
      return decoded;
    } catch (error) {
      return null;
    }
  },
  // Only accepts tokens that were created as refresh tokens
  verifyRefreshToken: (token: string): { userId: string } | null => {
    const decoded = AuthService.verifyToken(token);
    if (!decoded || typeof decoded === "string") return null;
    if (decoded.type !== "refresh" || typeof decoded.userId !== "string")
      return null;
    return { userId: decoded.userId };
  },
};

import { Request, Response } from "express";
import { BatchService } from "./service";
import { ResponseHandler } from "@/utils/response";
import { ErrorHandler } from "@/utils/error";
import { queryFilters } from "@/utils/queryFilters";
import { validateBatchCreate, validateBatchUpdate } from "./validator";

export const BatchController = {
  index: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { page, limit, search } = queryFilters(req);
      const courseId = req.query.courseId as string | undefined;
      const isActive = req.query.isActive !== undefined ? req.query.isActive === "true" : undefined;
      const pageNumber = Number(page) || 1;
      const limitNumber = Number(limit) || 10;

      const result = await BatchService.index({
        page: pageNumber,
        limit: limitNumber,
        search,
        courseId,
        isActive,
      });

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Batches fetched successfully!",
        data: {
          data: result.batches,
          pagination: result.pagination,
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  create: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const validatedData = validateBatchCreate(req.body);
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      const batch = await BatchService.create(validatedData, userId);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 201,
        message: "Batch created successfully",
        data: batch,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  retrieve: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const batch = await BatchService.getById(id);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Batch retrieved successfully",
        data: batch,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  update: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const validatedData = validateBatchUpdate(req.body);
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      const batch = await BatchService.update(id, validatedData, userId);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Batch updated successfully",
        data: batch,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  delete: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      await BatchService.delete(id, userId);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Batch deleted successfully",
        data: null,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { BatchCreateInput, BatchUpdateInput } from "./validator";

export const BatchService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; courseId?: string; isActive?: boolean }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.name = {
        contains: query.search,
        mode: "insensitive",
      };
    }

    if (query.courseId) {
      whereClause.courseId = query.courseId;
    }

    if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
      whereClause.isActive = query.isActive;
    }

    const [batches, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.batch.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          course: true,
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.batch.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      batches,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
      },
    };
  },

  async create(data: BatchCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // Validate that Course exists and is not soft-deleted
    const course = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { id: data.courseId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!course) {
      throw new CustomError("Course not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    // Validate that currentTermNumber does not exceed totalTerms
    if (data.currentTermNumber > course.totalTerms) {
      throw new CustomError(
        `Current term number (${data.currentTermNumber}) cannot exceed course total terms (${course.totalTerms})`,
        400
      );
    }

    // Check duplicate batch name within the same course
    const existing = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
      where: {
        courseId: data.courseId,
        name: data.name,
        deletedAt: null,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError("A batch with this name already exists for this course", 409);
    }

    try {
      const batch = await prismaMain.batch.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          course: true,
        },
      });
      return batch;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A batch with this name already exists for this course", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const batch = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        course: true,
      },
    });

    if (!batch) {
      throw new CustomError("Batch not found", 404);
    }

    return batch;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: BatchUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const batch = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!batch) {
      throw new CustomError("Batch not found", 404);
    }

    const targetCourseId = data.courseId || batch.courseId;

    // Validate course if changed or referenced
    const course = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { id: targetCourseId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!course) {
      throw new CustomError("Course not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    const targetTermNumber = data.currentTermNumber !== undefined ? data.currentTermNumber : batch.currentTermNumber;
    if (targetTermNumber > course.totalTerms) {
      throw new CustomError(
        `Current term number (${targetTermNumber}) cannot exceed course total terms (${course.totalTerms})`,
        400
      );
    }

    const targetName = data.name !== undefined ? data.name : batch.name;
    if (data.name || data.courseId) {
      const duplicate = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
        where: {
          courseId: targetCourseId,
          name: targetName,
          NOT: { id },
          deletedAt: null,
        },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new CustomError("A batch with this name already exists for this course", 409);
      }
    }

    try {
      const updated = await prismaMain.batch.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          course: true,
        },
      });
      return updated;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A batch with this name already exists for this course", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const batch = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!batch) {
      throw new CustomError("Batch not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.batch.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { BatchTermCreateInput, BatchTermUpdateInput } from "./validator";

export const BatchTermService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; batchId?: string; isActive?: boolean }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.name = { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" };
    }

    if (query.batchId) {
      whereClause.batchId = query.batchId;
    }

    if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
      whereClause.isActive = query.isActive;
    }

    const [batchTerms, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.batchTerm.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          batch: { include: { course: true } },
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.batchTerm.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      batchTerms,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
      },
    };
  },

  async create(data: BatchTermCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // Validate that Batch exists and is not soft-deleted
    const batch = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
      where: { id: data.batchId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!batch) {
      throw new CustomError("Batch not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    // Check duplicate term number within the same batch
    const existing = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
      where: {
        batchId: data.batchId,
        termNumber: data.termNumber,
        deletedAt: null,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError("A term with this number already exists for this batch", 409);
    }

    // Validate term number does not exceed course total terms
    const course = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { id: batch.courseId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (data.termNumber > course.totalTerms) {
      throw new CustomError(
        `Term number (${data.termNumber}) cannot exceed course total terms (${course.totalTerms})`,
        400,
      );
    }

    try {
      const batchTerm = await prismaMain.batchTerm.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          ...(userId && { createdBy: userId }),
        },
        include: {
          batch: { include: { course: true } },
        } as any,
      });
      return batchTerm;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A term with this number already exists for this batch", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const batchTerm = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        batch: { include: { course: true } },
        subjects: true,
        exams: true,
      },
    });

    if (!batchTerm) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTerm not found", 404);
    }

    return batchTerm;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: BatchTermUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const batchTerm = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!batchTerm) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTerm not found", 404);
    }

    // Validate batch if changed
    if (data.batchId && data.batchId !== batchTerm.batchId) {
      const batch = await prismaMain.batch.findFirst({
        where: { id: data.batchId, deletedAt: null },
      });
      if (!batch) {
        throw new CustomError("Batch not found or has been deleted", 404);
      }
    }

    // Check duplicate term number if changed
    if (data.termNumber !== undefined && data.termNumber !== batchTerm.termNumber) {
      const targetBatchId = data.batchId || batchTerm.batchId;
      const duplicate = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
        where: {
          batchId: targetBatchId,
          termNumber: data.termNumber,
          NOT: { id },
          deletedAt: null,
        },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new CustomError("A term with this number already exists for this batch", 409);
      }
    }

    try {
      const updated = await prismaMain.batchTerm.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          batch: { include: { course: true } },
        },
      });
      return updated;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A term with this number already exists for this batch", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const batchTerm = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!batchTerm) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTerm not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.batchTerm.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { BatchTermSubjectCreateInput, BatchTermSubjectUpdateInput } from "./validator";

export const BatchTermSubjectService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; batchTermId?: string; subjectId?: string; isElective?: boolean }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { subject: { name: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } } },
        { subject: { code: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } } },
      ];
    }

    if (query.batchTermId) {
      whereClause.batchTermId = query.batchTermId;
    }

    if (query.subjectId) {
      whereClause.subjectId = query.subjectId;
    }

    if (query.isElective !== undefined) {
      whereClause.isElective = query.isElective;
    }

    const [batchTermSubjects, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.batchTermSubject.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          subject: true,
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.batchTermSubject.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      batchTermSubjects,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
      },
    };
  },

  async create(data: BatchTermSubjectCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // Validate that BatchTerm exists and is not soft-deleted
    const batchTerm = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
      where: { id: data.batchTermId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!batchTerm) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTerm not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    // Validate that Subject exists and is not soft-deleted
    const subject = await prismaMain.subject.findFirst({
      where: { id: data.subjectId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!subject) {
      throw new CustomError("Subject not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    // Check duplicate combination of batchTerm + subject
    const existing = await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.findFirst({
      where: {
        batchTermId: data.batchTermId,
        subjectId: data.subjectId,
        deletedAt: null,
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError("This subject is already assigned to this batch term", 409);
    }

    try {
      const batchTermSubject = await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          subject: true,
        },
      });
      return batchTermSubject;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("This subject is already assigned to this batch term", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const batchTermSubject = await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        subject: true,
        assignments: true,
        examSubjects: true,
      },
    });

    if (!batchTermSubject) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTermSubject not found", 404);
    }

    return batchTermSubject;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: BatchTermSubjectUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTermSubject not found", 404);
    }

    // Validate batchTerm if changed
    if (data.batchTermId && data.batchTermId !== existing.batchTermId) {
      const batchTerm = await prismaMain.batchTerm.findFirst({
        where: { id: data.batchTermId, deletedAt: null },
      });
      if (!batchTerm) {
        throw new CustomError("BatchTerm not found or has been deleted", 404);
      }
    }

    // Validate subject if changed
    if (data.subjectId && data.subjectId !== existing.subjectId) {
      const subject = await prismaMain.subject.findFirst({
        where: { id: data.subjectId, deletedAt: null },
      });
      if (!subject) {
        throw new CustomError("Subject not found or has been deleted", 404);
      }
    }

    try {
      const updated = await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          subject: true,
        },
      });
      return updated;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("This subject is already assigned to this batch term", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("BatchTermSubject not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.batchTermSubject.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { Request, Response } from "express";

export const CourseController = {
  index: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { page, limit, search } = queryFilters(req);
      const isActive = req.query.isActive !== undefined ? req.query.isActive === "true" : undefined;
      const pageNumber = Number(page) || 1;

    }
  },

    try {
      const validatedData = validateCourseCreate(req.body);
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      });

      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const validatedData = validateCourseUpdate(req.body);

    }
  },

  delete: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { CourseCreateInput, CourseUpdateInput } from "./validator";

export const CourseService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; isActive?: boolean }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { name: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { code: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
      whereClause.isActive = query.isActive;
    }

    const [courses, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.course.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.course.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      courses,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
      },
    };
  },

  async create(data: CourseCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { code: data.code, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError("A course with this code already exists", 409);
    }

    try {
      const course = await prismaMain.course.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          ...(userId && { createdBy: userId }),
        } as any,
      });
      return course;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A course with this code already exists", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const course = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: { batches: true, feeStructures: true },
    });

    if (!course) {
      throw new CustomError("Course not found", 404);
    }

    return course;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: CourseUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const course = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!course) {
      throw new CustomError("Course not found", 404);
    }

    if (data.code) {
      const duplicate = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
        where: {
          code: data.code,
          NOT: { id },
          deletedAt: null,
        },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new CustomError("A course with this code already exists", 409);
      }
    }

    try {
      const updated = await prismaMain.course.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
      });
      return updated;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A course with this code already exists", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const course = await prismaMain.course.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!course) {
      throw new CustomError("Course not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.course.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};
