import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { TeacherBatchPayCreateInput, TeacherBatchPayUpdateInput } from "./validator";

export const TeacherBatchPayService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; teachingAssignmentId?: string; isActive?: boolean }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {};

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { ratePerCreditHour: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { fixedMonthlyAmount: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    if (query.teachingAssignmentId) {
      whereClause.teachingAssignmentId = query.teachingAssignmentId;
    }

    if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
      whereClause.effectiveFromBs = query.isActive
        ? { gte: new Date(new Date().toISOString()) }
        : { lt: new Date(new Date().toISOString()) };
    }

    const [pays, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          teachingAssignment: true,
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      pays,
      pagination: {
        page,
        limit,
        total,
      },
    };
  },

  async create(data: TeacherBatchPayCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // Validate teachingAssignment exists and is not soft-deleted
    const assignment = await prismaMain.teachingAssignment.findFirst({
      where: { id: data.teachingAssignmentId, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      throw new CustomError("Teaching assignment not found or has been deleted", 404);
    }

    try {
      const pay = await prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          teachingAssignment: true,
        },
      });
      return pay;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("Duplicate entry found", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const pay = await prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        teachingAssignment: true,
      },
    });

    if (!pay) {
      throw new CustomError("Teacher batch pay not found", 404);
    }

    return pay;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: TeacherBatchPayUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const pay = await prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!pay) {
      throw new CustomError("Teacher batch pay not found", 404);
    }

    try {
      const updated = await prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          teachingAssignment: true,
        },
      });
      return updated;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("Duplicate entry found", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const pay = await prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!pay) {
      throw new CustomError("Teacher batch pay not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.teacherBatchPay.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { TeachingAssignmentCreateInput } from "./validator";

export const TeachingAssignmentService = {
  async index(query: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit && query.limit > 0 ? query.limit : 10;
    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { teacherId: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    const [assignments, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.teachingAssignment.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take: limit,
        include: {
          attendances: true,
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.teachingAssignment.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: assignments,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: TeachingAssignmentCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    try {
      const assignment = await prismaMain.teachingAssignment.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
        include: {
          attendances: true,
        },
      });
      return assignment;
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("A teaching assignment with this subject already exists", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const assignment = await prismaMain.teachingAssignment.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      include: {
        attendances: true,
      },
    });

    if (!assignment) {
      throw new CustomError("Teaching assignment not found", 404);
    }

    return assignment;
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.teachingAssignment.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Teaching assignment not found", 404);
    }

    await prismaMain.teachingAssignment.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  delete: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      await UserService.delete(id, userId);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "User deleted successfully",
        data: null,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
};

import bcrypt from "bcrypt";
import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { calculateSkipAndTake } from "@/utils/queryFilters";
import { UserCreateInput, UserUpdateInput } from "@/generated/prisma/models";
import { UserResetPasswordInput } from "./validator";


const SALT_ROUNDS = 10;

// passwordHash must never leave the server
const userSelect = {
  id: true,
  email: true,
  username: true,
  role: true,
  isAdmin: true,
  isActive: true,
  isEmailVerified: true,
  lastLoginAt: true,
  failedLoginCount: true,
  lockedUntil: true,
  createdAt: true,
  updatedAt: true,
  employee: {
    select: { id: true, employeeCode: true, firstName: true, lastName: true },
  },
  student: {
    select: {
      id: true,
      universityRegNo: true,
      firstName: true,
      lastName: true,
    },
  },
};

export const UserService = {
  async index(query: {
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
    search?: string;
    role?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
  }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit ? query.limit : 10;
    const { skip, take } = calculateSkipAndTake(page, limit);

    const whereClause: any = { deletedAt: null };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { email: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { username: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    if (query.role) whereClause.role = query.role;
    if (query.isActive !== undefined) whereClause.isActive = query.isActive;

    const [users, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.user.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take,
        select: userSelect,
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.user.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return { data: users, pagination: { page, limit, total } };
  },

  async create(data: UserCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // Unique indexes also cover soft-deleted rows, so check without the deletedAt filter
    const emailTaken = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
      where: { email: data.email },
    });
    if (emailTaken) {
      throw new CustomError("Email is already taken", 409);
    }

    if (data.username) {
      const usernameTaken = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { username: data.username },
      });
      if (usernameTaken) {
        throw new CustomError("Username is already taken", 409);
      }
    }

    const { password, ...rest } = data;
    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, SALT_ROUNDS);

    try {
      return await prismaMain.user.create({
        data: {
          ...rest,
          passwordHash,
          isAdmin: rest.role === "ADMIN",
          createdBy: userId,
        },
        select: userSelect,
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("Email or username is already taken", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const user = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
      select: userSelect,
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw new CustomError("User not found", 404);
    }

    return user;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: UserUpdateInput, actingUserId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("User not found", 404);
    }

    // An admin must not lock themselves out or demote themselves
    if (id === actingUserId) {
      if (data.isActive === false) {
        throw new CustomError("You cannot deactivate your own account", 400);
      }
      if (data.role && data.role !== existing.role) {
        throw new CustomError("You cannot change your own role", 400);
      }
    }

    if (data.email && data.email !== existing.email) {
      const emailTaken = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { email: data.email, NOT: { id } },
      });
      if (emailTaken) {
        throw new CustomError("Email is already taken", 409);
      }
    }

    if (data.username && data.username !== existing.username) {
      const usernameTaken = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
        where: { username: data.username, NOT: { id } },
      });
      if (usernameTaken) {
        throw new CustomError("Username is already taken", 409);
      }
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.user.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          ...(data.role ? { isAdmin: data.role === "ADMIN" } : {}),
          updatedBy: actingUserId,
        },
        select: userSelect,
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError("Email or username is already taken", 409);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async resetPassword(
    id: string,
    data: UserResetPasswordInput,
    actingUserId?: string,
  ) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("User not found", 404);
    }

    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(data.password, SALT_ROUNDS);

    await prismaMain.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        passwordHash,
        failedLoginCount: 0,
        lockedUntil: null,
        updatedBy: actingUserId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },

  // Clears a lock caused by too many failed logins
  async unlock(id: string, actingUserId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("User not found", 404);
    }

    return prismaMain.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { failedLoginCount: 0, lockedUntil: null, updatedBy: actingUserId },
      select: userSelect,
    });
  },

  async delete(id: string, actingUserId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.user.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("User not found", 404);
    }

    if (id === actingUserId) {
      throw new CustomError("You cannot delete your own account", 400);
    }

    // Keep at least one active admin in the system
    if (existing.role === "ADMIN") {
      const otherAdmins = await prismaMain.user.count({
        where: { role: "ADMIN", isActive: true, deletedAt: null, NOT: { id } },
      });
      if (otherAdmins === 0) {
        throw new CustomError("Cannot delete the last active admin", 400);
      }
    }

    await prismaMain.user.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { deletedAt: new Date(), isActive: false, updatedBy: actingUserId },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

  "ADMIN",
  "PRINCIPAL",
  "ACCOUNTANT",
  "TEACHER",
  "STAFF",
  "STUDENT",

    .string()
    .trim()

    .max(128),

import { Request, Response } from "express";
import { ResponseHandler } from "@/utils/response";
import { ErrorHandler } from "@/utils/error";
import { queryFilters } from "@/utils/queryFilters";
import {
  validateWorkflowStatusCreate,
  validateWorkflowStatusUpdate,
} from "./validator";
import { WorkflowStatusService } from "./service";

export const WorkflowStatusController = {
  index: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const { page, limit, search } = queryFilters(req);
      const pageNumber = Number(page) || 1;
      const limitNumber = Number(limit) || 10;
      const isActive =
        req.query.isActive !== undefined
          ? req.query.isActive === "true"
          : undefined;

      const result = await WorkflowStatusService.index({
        page: pageNumber,
        limit: limitNumber,
        search,
        isActive,
      });

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Workflow statuses fetched successfully!",
        data: {
          data: result.data,
          pagination: result.pagination,
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  create: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const validatedData = validateWorkflowStatusCreate(req.body);
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      const item = await WorkflowStatusService.create(validatedData, userId);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 201,
        message: "Workflow status created successfully",
        data: item,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  retrieve: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const item = await WorkflowStatusService.getById(id);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Workflow status retrieved successfully",
        data: item,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  update: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const validatedData = validateWorkflowStatusUpdate(req.body);
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      const item = await WorkflowStatusService.update(
        id,
        validatedData,
        userId,
      );

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Workflow status updated successfully",
        data: item,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },

  delete: async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const id = req.params.id as string;
      const userId = res.locals.context?.userId;

      await WorkflowStatusService.delete(id, userId);

      return ResponseHandler.success({
        res,
        code: 200,
        message: "Workflow status deleted successfully",
        data: null,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return ErrorHandler.handleError(res, error);
    }
  },
};

import { prismaMain } from "@/lib/prismaClient";
import { CustomError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import { calculateSkipAndTake } from "@/utils/queryFilters";
import {
  WorkflowStatusCreateInput,
  WorkflowStatusUpdateInput,
} from "./validator";

export const WorkflowStatusService = {
  async index(query: {
    page?: number;
    limit?: number;
    search?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
  }) {
    const page = query.page && query.page > 0 ? query.page : 1;
    const limit = query.limit ? query.limit : 10; // limit = -1 returns everything (useful for dropdowns)
    const { skip, take } = calculateSkipAndTake(page, limit);

    const whereClause: any = {
      deletedAt: null,
    };

    if (query.search) {
      whereClause.OR = [
        { code: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { name: { contains: query.search, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }

    if (query.isActive !== undefined) {
      whereClause.isActive = query.isActive;
    }

    const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.workflowStatus.findMany({
        where: whereClause,
        skip,
        take,
        orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      }),
      prismaMain.workflowStatus.count({ where: whereClause }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: items,
      pagination: { page, limit, total },
    };
  },

  async create(data: WorkflowStatusCreateInput, userId?: string) {
    // The unique index on code also covers soft-deleted rows, so check without the deletedAt filter
    const existing = await prismaMain.workflowStatus.findFirst({
      where: { code: data.code },
    });

    if (existing) {
      throw new CustomError(
        existing.deletedAt
          ? "A deleted workflow status already uses this code. Use a different code."
          : "A workflow status with this code already exists",
        409,
      );
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.workflowStatus.create({
        data: {
          ...data,
          createdBy: userId,
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError(
          "A workflow status with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async getById(id: string) {
    const item = await prismaMain.workflowStatus.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!item) {
      throw new CustomError("Workflow status not found", 404);
    }

    return item;
  },

  async update(id: string, data: WorkflowStatusUpdateInput, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.workflowStatus.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Workflow status not found", 404);
    }

    if (data.code && data.code !== existing.code) {
      const duplicate = await prismaMain.workflowStatus.findFirst({
        where: { code: data.code, NOT: { id } },
      });

      if (duplicate) {
        throw new CustomError(
          "A workflow status with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
    }

    try {
      return await prismaMain.workflowStatus.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...data,
          updatedBy: userId,
        },
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (error.code === "P2002") {
        throw new CustomError(
          "A workflow status with this code already exists",
          409,
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async delete(id: string, userId?: string) {
    const existing = await prismaMain.workflowStatus.findFirst({
      where: { id, deletedAt: null },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      throw new CustomError("Workflow status not found", 404);
    }

    // Block deletion while other records still reference this row
    const usage = await Promise.all([
      prismaMain.student.count({
        where: { approvalStatusId: id, deletedAt: null },
      }),
      prismaMain.result.count({
        where: { workflowStatusId: id, deletedAt: null },
      }),
      prismaMain.payroll.count({
        where: { workflowStatusId: id, deletedAt: null },
      }),
    ]);

    if (usage.some((count) => count > 0)) {
      throw new CustomError(
        "This workflow status is in use and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.",
        409,
      );
    }

    await prismaMain.workflowStatus.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        deletedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  },
};

import type { CookieOptions } from "express";

const parseSeconds = (value: string | undefined, fallback: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback;
};

const defaultAccessTtl = parseSeconds(process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN, 900);
const defaultRefreshTtl = parseSeconds(
  process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN,
  86400,
);

const baseCookieOptions: CookieOptions = {
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: true,
  sameSite: "none",
};

const buildCookieOptions = (ttlSeconds: number): CookieOptions => ({
  ...baseCookieOptions,
  maxAge: ttlSeconds * 1000,
});

export const CookieManager = {
  accessToken: () => buildCookieOptions(defaultAccessTtl),
  refreshToken: () => buildCookieOptions(defaultRefreshTtl),
};

import { CustomError, ValidationError } from "@/errors/CustomError";
import {
  PrismaClientInitializationError,
  PrismaClientKnownRequestError,
  PrismaClientRustPanicError,
  PrismaClientUnknownRequestError,
  PrismaClientValidationError,
} from "@prisma/client/runtime/client";
import { AxiosError } from "axios";
import { Response } from "express";
import { ZodError } from "zod";
import { ResponseHandler } from "./response";
type PrismaError =
  | PrismaClientInitializationError
  | PrismaClientKnownRequestError
  | PrismaClientRustPanicError
  | PrismaClientValidationError
  | PrismaClientUnknownRequestError;

export const ErrorHandler = {
  // Handle error
  handleError: function (res: Response, error: unknown) {
    if (error instanceof ValidationError)
      return this.handleValidationError(res, error);
    else if (error instanceof CustomError)
      return this.handleCustomError(res, error);
    else if (error instanceof ZodError) return this.handleZodError(res, error);
    else if (error instanceof AxiosError)
      return this.handleAxiosError(res, error);

    // Handle standard Error instances
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      return ResponseHandler.error({
        res,
        code: 500,
        message: "Internal Server Error",
        error: error.message,
      });
    }

    return ResponseHandler.error({
      res,
      code: 500,
      message: "Internal Server Error",
      error: null,
    });
  },

  // Handle custom error
  handleCustomError: function (res: Response, error: CustomError) {
    return ResponseHandler.error({
      res,
      code: error.status || 500,
      message: error.message || "Internal Server Error",
      error: null,
    });
  },

  // Handle validation error
  handleValidationError: function (res: Response, error: ValidationError) {
    return res.status(422).send({
      success: false,
      status: 422,
      message: "Validation Error",
      data: error.fields,
    });
  },

  handlePrismaError: function (error: PrismaError) {
    switch (error.name) {
      case "PrismaClientInitializationError":
        // Return the error response json
        return {
          success: false,
          status: 500,
          message: "Server error occured. Our engineers are already notified.",
          data: null,
        };
      default:
        // Return the error response json
        return {
          success: false,
          status: 500,
          message: "Server error occured. Our engineers are already notified.",
          data: null,
        };
    }
  },

  handleZodError: function (res: Response, error: ZodError) {
    // Flatten the errors
    const flattenedErrors: Record<string, unknown> =
      error.flatten().fieldErrors;
    /**
     * In case a custom data is thrown from zod object via params object
     * That needs to be respected. Simply flattening the errors
     * Will only return message and not the custom data
     * Hence we need to check if params exists and if it does
     * We need to replace the message with the custom data
     * To see the usage of params, see validation of invoiceEmails in client validation (clients/validator.tsx) file
     */
    // for each issue
    for (const issue of error.issues) {
      const issuePaths = issue.path;
      // for each path, check if issue.params exists
      for (const path of issuePaths) {
        // if issue.params exists, check if errors exists
        if ("params" in issue && issue.params) {
          // if errors exists, add it to flattenedErrors
          flattenedErrors[String(path)] = issue.params;
        }
      }
    }

    return res.status(422).send({
      success: false,
      status: 422,
      message: "Validation Error",
      data: { ...flattenedErrors, _deepErrors: error },
    });
  },

  // handleJWTError: function (error: JsonWebTokenError) {
  //   // Return the error response json
  //   return { success: false, status: 401, message: 'Invalid Authorization Token', data: [] };
  // },

  handleAxiosError: function (res: Response, error: AxiosError) {
    const status = error.response?.status || 500;
    const responseData = error.response?.data as
      | { message?: string }
      | undefined;
    const message = responseData?.message || error.message || "Request failed";
    return ResponseHandler.error({ res, code: status, message, error: null });
  },
};

import type { Request } from "express";

type Query = {
  limit?: string | number;
  page?: string | number;
  search?: string;
};

export function queryFilters(req: Request) {
  const source = (req.query ?? req.body ?? {}) as Query;
  const { limit, page, search } = source;
  return { limit, page, search };
}

// Calculate skip and take
export const calculateSkipAndTake = (
  page: number,
  limit: number,
): { skip: number; take: number | undefined } => {
  // Calculate the skip and take
  const skip = limit === -1 ? 0 : (page - 1) * limit;
  const take = limit !== -1 ? limit : undefined;

  return { skip, take };
};

import type { Request, Response } from "express";
import moment from "moment";

export const ResponseHandler = {
  success: (args: {
    res: Response;
    code: number;
    message: string;
    data: unknown;
    pagination?: unknown;
  }) => {
    const { res, code, message, data } = args;
    return res.status(code).json({
      success: true,
      code,
      message,
      data,
      meta: ResponseHandler.meta({ res }),
    });
  },

  error: (args: {
    res: Response;
    code: number;
    message: string;
    error: unknown;
  }) => {
    const { res, code, message, error } = args;
    return res.status(code).send({
      success: false,
      code,
      message,
      error,
      meta: ResponseHandler.meta({ res }),
    });
  },

  notfound: (args: { res: Response }) => {
    const { res } = args;
    return res.status(404).json({
      success: false,
      code: 404,
      message: "Not Found",
      data: null,
      meta: ResponseHandler.meta({ res }),
    });
  },

  meta: (args: { res: Response }) => {
    const { res } = args;
    return {
      requestId: res.locals.requestId,
      timestamp: moment().toISOString(),
      unix: moment().unix(),
    };
  },
};

import "dotenv/config";
import express from "express";
import cookieParser from "cookie-parser";
import cors from "cors";
import morgan from "morgan";
import { trimBody } from "./middlewares/trimBody.js";
import appRoutes from "./router.js";
import { prismaMain } from "./lib/prismaClient.js";
import { seedDefaultAdmin } from "./dev/seedDefaultAdmin.js";
import docsRouter from "./docs/swagger.js";

const app = express();
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 8000;
const CORS_ORIGIN = process.env.CORS_ORIGIN || "http://localhost:5173";

app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(cookieParser());
app.use(morgan("dev"));
app.use(cors({ origin: CORS_ORIGIN, credentials: true }));

app.get("/", (req, res) => res.json({ message: "COLLIFY API running" }));
app.get("/health", (req, res) =>
  res.json({ status: "ok", time: new Date().toISOString() }),
);

// Docs - always works, never crashes
app.use("/api-docs", docsRouter);

app.use("/api", trimBody, appRoutes);

app.use((req, res) =>
  res.status(404).json({ success: false, message: "Route not found" }),
);

async function main() {
  try {
    await prismaMain.$connect();
    console.log("✓ DB connected");
    await seedDefaultAdmin();
    app.listen(PORT, () => {
      console.log(`✓ Server: http://localhost:${PORT}`);
      console.log(`✓ Modern Docs (Scalar): http://localhost:${PORT}/api-docs`);
      console.log(`✓ Swagger UI: http://localhost:${PORT}/api-docs/swagger`);
      console.log(`✓ OpenAPI JSON: http://localhost:${PORT}/api-docs/json`);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("✗ Start failed:", e);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
main();

$root = 'C:\Users\user\OneDrive\Documents\GitHub\COLLIFY\POS-Backend-Node'
Get-ChildItem "$root\src\modules" | ForEach-Object {
    $name = $_.Name
    $routesFile = Join-Path $_.FullName 'routes.ts'
    if (Test-Path $routesFile) {
        $content = Get-Content $routesFile -Raw
        $lines = ($content | Measure-Object -Line).Lines
        Write-Output ("OK: " + $name + " (" + $lines + " lines)")
    } else {
        Write-Output ("MISSING ROUTES: " + $name)
    }
}
